24: ) (map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup, error) {
25: 	containers, err := c.ListContainers(ctx, WithListLabName(c.Config.Name))
26: 	if err != nil {
27: 		return nil, err
28: 	}
29: 
30: 	result := make(map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup)
31: 	var duplicates []string
32: 
33: 	for _, ctr := range containers {
34: 		if ctr.Labels[clabconstants.ToolType] != "" {
35: 			continue
36: 		}
37: 
38: 		nodeName := ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName]
39: 		if nodeName == "" {
40: 			continue
41: 		}
42: 
43: 		groupName := ctr.Labels[clabconstants.RootNodeName]
44: 		distributed := groupName != ""
45: 		if groupName == "" {
46: 			groupName = nodeName
47: 		}
48: 
49: 		group, exists := result[groupName]
50: 		if !exists {
51: 			group = &runtimeNodeGroup{
52: 				name:        groupName,
53: 				distributed: distributed,
54: 			}
55: 			result[groupName] = group
56: 		}
57: 		group.containers = append(group.containers, ctr)
58: 		group.distributed = group.distributed || distributed
59: 
60: 		if !group.distributed && len(group.containers) > 1 {
61: 			duplicates = append(duplicates, nodeName)
62: 			continue
63: 		}
64: 	}
65: 
66: 	// Pre-existing resources have no containerlab labels, but still participate in apply.
67: 	for nodeName, node := range c.Nodes {
68: 		cfg := node.Config()
69: 		if cfg == nil {
70: 			continue
71: 		}
72: 		if _, exists := result[nodeName]; exists {
73: 			continue
74: 		}
75: 		if cfg.IsRootNamespaceBased {
76: 			result[nodeName] = &runtimeNodeGroup{
77: 				name:               nodeName,
78: 				rootNamespaceBased: true,
79: 			}
80: 			continue
81: 		}
82: 		if !cfg.SkipUniquenessCheck || node.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {
83: 			continue
84: 		}
85: 		result[nodeName] = &runtimeNodeGroup{name: nodeName, external: true}
86: 	}
87: 
88: 	if len(duplicates) > 0 {
89: 		sort.Strings(duplicates)
90: 		return nil, fmt.Errorf(
91: 			"apply supports only single-container nodes, found multiple containers for nodes: %s",
92: 			strings.Join(duplicates, ", "),
93: 		)
94: 	}
95: 
96: 	for _, group := range result {
97: 		sort.Slice(group.containers, func(i, j int) bool {
98: 			return runtimeContainerLess(group.containers[i], group.containers[j])
99: 		})
100: 	}
101: 
102: 	return result, nil
103: }
104: 
105: // NeedsInitialDeploy reports whether the lab has no runtime state yet, i.e. whether
106: // Deploy would perform a fresh deployment instead of reconciling a running lab.
107: func (c *CLab) NeedsInitialDeploy(ctx context.Context) (bool, error) {
108: 	if c.LabRuntime != nil {
109: 		checker, ok := c.LabRuntime.(clablabruntime.LabExistenceChecker)
110: 		if !ok {
111: 			return false, fmt.Errorf(
112: 				"lab runtime %q cannot determine whether the lab already exists",
113: 				c.globalRuntimeName,
114: 			)
115: 		}
116: 		exists, err := checker.LabExists(ctx, clablabruntime.InspectRequest{
117: 			Name:     c.Config.Name,
118: 			Identity: c.labRuntimeIdentity,
119: 		})
120: 
121: 		return !exists, err
122: 	}
123: 
124: 	currentNodes, err := c.runtimeNodeGroups(ctx)
125: 	if err != nil {
126: 		return false, err
127: 	}
128: 
129: 	return c.needsInitialDeploy(currentNodes)
130: }
131: 
132: func (c *CLab) needsInitialDeploy(currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup) (bool, error) {
133: 	if len(currentNodes) == 0 {
134: 		return true, nil
135: 	}
136: 	for _, node := range currentNodes {
137: 		if !node.external && !node.rootNamespaceBased {
138: 			return false, nil
139: 		}
140: 	}
141: 
142: 	state, err := c.LoadState()
143: 	return state == nil, err
144: }
145: 
146: func (c *CLab) setMgmtBridgeFromRuntime(
147: 	currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup,
148: ) error {
149: 	if c.Config.Mgmt.Bridge != "" {
150: 		return nil
151: 	}
152: 
153: 	var bridge string
154: 	for _, runtimeNode := range currentNodes {
155: 		for _, ctr := range runtimeNode.containers {
156: 			// only containers attached to the default management network, or
157: 			// without a runtime network, carry the default network's bridge
158: 			// label. Unknown networks, e.g. ones dropped from the mgmt list,
159: 			// must not contribute their bridge.
160: 			switch ctr.NetworkName {
161: 			case "", c.Config.Mgmt.Network:
162: 			default:
163: 				continue
164: 			}
165: 			ctrBridge := ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeMgmtNetBr]
166: 			if ctrBridge == "" {
167: 				continue
168: 			}
169: 			if bridge == "" {
170: 				bridge = ctrBridge
171: 				continue
172: 			}
173: 			if bridge != ctrBridge {
174: 				return fmt.Errorf(
175: 					"runtime lab has conflicting management bridge labels: %q and %q",
176: 					bridge,
177: 					ctrBridge,
178: 				)
179: 			}
180: 		}
181: 	}
182: 
183: 	if bridge != "" {
184: 		c.Config.Mgmt.Bridge = bridge
185: 	}
186: 
187: 	return nil
188: }
189: 
190: func (c *CLab) updateRuntimeInfoForExistingNodes(ctx context.Context) error {
191: 	for _, nodeName := range sortedNodeNames(c.Nodes) {
192: 		node := c.Nodes[nodeName]
193: 		if node.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {
194: 			continue
195: 		}
196: 		if err := node.UpdateConfigWithRuntimeInfo(ctx); err != nil {
197: 			return fmt.Errorf("failed to update runtime info for node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
198: 		}
199: 	}
200: 
201: 	return nil
202: }
203: 
204: func sortedRuntimeNodeGroupNames(nodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup) []string {
205: 	names := make([]string, 0, len(nodes))
206: 	for name := range nodes {
207: 		names = append(names, name)
208: 	}
209: 	sort.Strings(names)
210: 	return names
211: }
212: 
213: func runtimeContainerNodeName(ctr clabruntime.GenericContainer) string {
214: 	if name := ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName]; name != "" {
215: 		return name
216: 	}
217: 	if len(ctr.Names) > 0 {
218: 		return ctr.Names[0]
219: 	}
220: 	return ctr.ID
221: }
222: 
223: func runtimeContainerLess(a, b clabruntime.GenericContainer) bool {
224: 	aName := runtimeContainerNodeName(a)
225: 	bName := runtimeContainerNodeName(b)
226: 
227: 	aOrder := runtimeComponentSortOrder(aName)
228: 	bOrder := runtimeComponentSortOrder(bName)
229: 	if aOrder != bOrder {
230: 		return aOrder < bOrder
231: 	}
232: 
233: 	return aName < bName
234: }
235: 
236: func runtimeComponentSortOrder(name string) int {
237: 	idx := strings.LastIndex(name, "-")
238: 	if idx < 0 || idx == len(name)-1 {
239: 		return 0
240: 	}
241: 
242: 	slot := strings.ToUpper(name[idx+1:])
243: 	if len(slot) == 1 && slot[0] >= 'A' && slot[0] <= 'Z' {
244: 		return 100 - int(slot[0])
245: 	}
246: 
247: 	var n int
248: 	for _, r := range slot {
249: 		if r < '0' || r > '9' {
250: 			return 0
251: 		}
252: 		n = n*10 + int(r-'0')
253: 	}
254: 
255: 	return n
256: }

package srl

import (
	"context"
	"testing"

	"github.com/docker/go-connections/nat"
	clabconstants "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/constants"
	clabmocksmockruntime "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/mocks/mockruntime"
	clabnodes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/nodes"
	clabruntime "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/runtime"
	clabtypes "github.com/srl-labs/containerlab/types"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/assert"
	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"
	"go.uber.org/mock/gomock"
)

const (
	testNodeName   = "clab-test-srl1"
	testNetnsName  = "clab-test-srl1-netns"
	testNetnsShort = "srl1-netns"
)

func newSRLTestConfig(t *testing.T) *clabtypes.NodeConfig {
	t.Helper()

	return &clabtypes.NodeConfig{
		ShortName:   "srl1",
		LongName:    testNodeName,
		Kind:        srlLongPlatformName,
		Image:       "srlinux:test",
		LabDir:      t.TempDir(),
		Env:         map[string]string{"FOO": "bar"},
		Sysctls:     map[string]string{},
		Labels:      map[string]string{clabconstants.Containerlab: "test"},
		Certificate: &clabtypes.CertificateConfig{},
	}
}

func newSRLTestNode(
	t *testing.T,
	cfg *clabtypes.NodeConfig,
	rt clabruntime.ContainerRuntime,
) *srl {
	t.Helper()

	n := &srl{}
	require.NoError(t, n.Init(cfg, clabnodes.WithRuntime(rt)))

	return n
}

func TestNetnsNodeConfig(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := newSRLTestConfig(t)
	cfg.MgmtIPv4Address = "172.20.20.10"
	n := newSRLTestNode(t, cfg, nil)

	require.NotNil(t, n.netnsNode)
	holder := n.netnsNode.Config()

	assert.Equal(t, "unless-stopped", n.Cfg.RestartPolicy)
	assert.Equal(t, testNetnsShort, holder.ShortName)
	assert.Equal(t, testNetnsName, holder.LongName)
	assert.Equal(t, n.Cfg.ShortName, holder.GetHostname())
	assert.Equal(t, n.Cfg.Image, holder.Image)
	assert.Equal(t, n.Cfg.RestartPolicy, holder.RestartPolicy)
	assert.Equal(t, n.Cfg.MgmtIPv4Address, holder.MgmtIPv4Address)
	assert.Equal(t, n.Cfg.Sysctls, holder.Sysctls)
	assert.Equal(t, "/bin/sh", holder.Entrypoint)
	assert.Empty(t, holder.Env)
	assert.Empty(t, holder.Binds)
	assert.Equal(t, "true", holder.Labels[clabconstants.InternalNode])
	assert.Equal(t, netnsNodeType, holder.Labels[clabconstants.NodeType])
	assert.Equal(t, n.Cfg.ShortName, holder.Labels[clabconstants.RootNodeName])
	assert.Equal(t, n.Cfg.LongName, holder.Labels[clabconstants.RootNodeLongName])
	assert.Empty(t, n.Cfg.Labels[clabconstants.InternalNode])
}

func TestUserRestartPolicyIsKept(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := newSRLTestConfig(t)
	cfg.RestartPolicy = "no"
	n := newSRLTestNode(t, cfg, nil)

	assert.Equal(t, "no", n.Cfg.RestartPolicy)
	assert.Equal(t, "no", n.netnsNode.Config().RestartPolicy)
}

func TestUserNetworkModeSkipsNetnsNode(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := newSRLTestConfig(t)
	cfg.NetworkMode = "host"
	n := newSRLTestNode(t, cfg, nil)

	assert.Nil(t, n.netnsNode)
	assert.Equal(t, "unless-stopped", n.Cfg.RestartPolicy)
}

func TestContainerConfigUsesNetnsNode(t *testing.T) {
	cfg := newSRLTestConfig(t)
	cfg.DNS = &clabtypes.DNSConfig{Servers: []string{"1.1.1.1"}}
	cfg.ExtraHosts = []string{"srl2:172.20.20.3"}
	cfg.MacAddress = "02:00:00:00:00:01"
	cfg.PortSet = nat.PortSet{"443/tcp": struct{}{}}
	cfg.PortBindings = nat.PortMap{"443/tcp": []nat.PortBinding{{HostPort: "50443"}}}
	n := newSRLTestNode(t, cfg, nil)

	got := n.containerConfig()

	assert.Equal(t, "container:"+testNetnsShort, got.NetworkMode)
	assert.Nil(t, got.DNS)
	assert.Nil(t, got.ExtraHosts)
	assert.Empty(t, got.MacAddress)
	assert.Nil(t, got.PortBindings)
	assert.Nil(t, got.PortSet)
	assert.Equal(t, n.Cfg.Entrypoint, got.Entrypoint)
	assert.Equal(t, n.Cfg.Cmd, got.Cmd)
	assert.Equal(t, "bar", got.Env["FOO"])

	// the node config keeps the network settings, they are applied to the holder
	assert.Empty(t, n.Cfg.NetworkMode)
	assert.Equal(t, []string{"srl2:172.20.20.3"}, n.Cfg.ExtraHosts)
	assert.NotNil(t, n.Cfg.DNS)
}

func TestGetContainersUsesNetnsNodeNetwork(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	rt := clabmocksmockruntime.NewMockContainerRuntime(gomock.NewController(t))
	n := newSRLTestNode(t, newSRLTestConfig(t), rt)

	ports := []*clabtypes.GenericPortBinding{{HostPort: 50443, ContainerPort: 443}}
	holder := clabruntime.GenericContainer{
		Names:       []string{testNetnsName},
		NetworkName: "clab",
		NetworkSettings: clabruntime.GenericMgmtIPs{
			IPv4addr: "172.20.20.10",
			IPv4pLen: 24,
			IPv6addr: "3fff:172:20:20::10",
			IPv6pLen: 64,
		},
		Ports: ports,
	}

	rt.EXPECT().ListContainers(ctx, []*clabtypes.GenericFilter{
		{FilterType: "name", Match: testNodeName},
	}).Return([]clabruntime.GenericContainer{{Names: []string{testNodeName}, ID: "srl"}}, nil)
	rt.EXPECT().ListContainers(ctx, []*clabtypes.GenericFilter{
		{FilterType: "name", Match: testNetnsName},
	}).Return([]clabruntime.GenericContainer{holder}, nil)

	got, err := n.GetContainers(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Len(t, got, 1)
	assert.Equal(t, "srl", got[0].ID)
	assert.Equal(t, holder.NetworkName, got[0].NetworkName)
	assert.Equal(t, holder.NetworkSettings, got[0].NetworkSettings)
	assert.Equal(t, ports, got[0].Ports)
}

func TestGetContainersReturnsNetnsNodeWhenNodeIsMissing(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	rt := clabmocksmockruntime.NewMockContainerRuntime(gomock.NewController(t))
	n := newSRLTestNode(t, newSRLTestConfig(t), rt)

	holder := clabruntime.GenericContainer{Names: []string{testNetnsName}}

	rt.EXPECT().ListContainers(ctx, []*clabtypes.GenericFilter{
		{FilterType: "name", Match: testNodeName},
	}).Return(nil, nil)
	rt.EXPECT().ListContainers(ctx, []*clabtypes.GenericFilter{
		{FilterType: "name", Match: testNetnsName},
	}).Return([]clabruntime.GenericContainer{holder}, nil)

	got, err := n.GetContainers(ctx)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	assert.Equal(t, []clabruntime.GenericContainer{holder}, got)
}

func TestDeleteRemovesNetnsNode(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	rt := clabmocksmockruntime.NewMockContainerRuntime(gomock.NewController(t))
	n := newSRLTestNode(t, newSRLTestConfig(t), rt)

	gomock.InOrder(
		rt.EXPECT().GetContainerStatus(ctx, testNodeName).Return(clabruntime.Running),
		rt.EXPECT().DeleteContainer(ctx, testNodeName).Return(nil),
		rt.EXPECT().GetContainerStatus(ctx, testNetnsName).Return(clabruntime.Running),
		rt.EXPECT().DeleteContainer(ctx, testNetnsName).Return(nil),
	)

	require.NoError(t, n.Delete(ctx))
}

func TestStopStopsNetnsNode(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()

	t.Run("running holder is stopped", func(t *testing.T) {
		rt := clabmocksmockruntime.NewMockContainerRuntime(gomock.NewController(t))
		n := newSRLTestNode(t, newSRLTestConfig(t), rt)

		rt.EXPECT().GetContainerStatus(ctx, testNodeName).Return(clabruntime.Stopped)
		rt.EXPECT().GetContainerStatus(ctx, testNetnsName).Return(clabruntime.Running)
		rt.EXPECT().StopContainer(ctx, testNetnsName, clabtypes.SIGTERM).Return(nil)

		require.NoError(t, n.Stop(ctx))
	})

	t.Run("stopped holder is left alone", func(t *testing.T) {
		rt := clabmocksmockruntime.NewMockContainerRuntime(gomock.NewController(t))
		n := newSRLTestNode(t, newSRLTestConfig(t), rt)

		rt.EXPECT().GetContainerStatus(ctx, testNodeName).Return(clabruntime.Stopped)
		rt.EXPECT().GetContainerStatus(ctx, testNetnsName).Return(clabruntime.Stopped)

		require.NoError(t, n.Stop(ctx))
	})
}

func TestStartRequiresNetnsNode(t *testing.T) {
	ctx := context.Background()
	rt := clabmocksmockruntime.NewMockContainerRuntime(gomock.NewController(t))
	n := newSRLTestNode(t, newSRLTestConfig(t), rt)

	rt.EXPECT().GetContainerStatus(ctx, testNetnsName).Return(clabruntime.NotFound)

	err := n.Start(ctx)
	require.Error(t, err)
	assert.Contains(t, err.Error(), "recreate the node")
}

284: 		}
285: 	}

287: 	if err := c.verifyDuplicateAddresses(); err != nil {
288: 		return err

295: 	ctx context.Context,

326: 				return err

328: 		}

336: 	currentNodes map[string]*runtimeNodeGroup,

638: func (c *CLab) deployNodes(
639: 	ctx context.Context,
640: 	nodeNames []string,
641: 	maxWorkers uint,
642: 	startNodeSet map[string]struct{},
643: ) error {
644: 	if len(nodeNames) == 0 {
645: 		return nil
646: 	}
647: 
648: 	if maxWorkers == 0 || int(maxWorkers) > len(nodeNames) {
649: 		maxWorkers = uint(len(nodeNames))
650: 	}
651: 	if _, err := c.networkModeNodeOrder(nodeNames); err != nil {
652: 		return err
653: 	}
654: 
655: 	input := make(chan string)
656: 	errCh := make(chan error, len(nodeNames))
657: 	completed := make(map[string]*nodeDeployCompletion, len(nodeNames))
658: 	for _, name := range nodeNames {
659: 		completed[name] = &nodeDeployCompletion{done: make(chan struct{})}
660: 	}
661: 	finish := func(name string, err error) {
662: 		completed[name].err = err
663: 		close(completed[name].done)
664: 		errCh <- err
665: 	}
666: 
667: 	for range maxWorkers {
668: 		go func() {
669: 			for nodeName := range input {
670: 				if _, start := startNodeSet[nodeName]; start {
671: 					log.Info("Starting stopped node", "node", nodeName)
672: 					err := c.Nodes[nodeName].Start(ctx)
673: 					if err != nil {
674: 						err = fmt.Errorf("failed starting node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
675: 					}
676: 					finish(nodeName, err)
677: 					continue
678: 				}
679: 				log.Info("Creating node", "node", nodeName)
680: 				finish(nodeName, c.deployNode(ctx, c.Nodes[nodeName]))
681: 			}
682: 		}()
683: 	}
684: 
685: 	// Wait outside the worker pool. Targets in this operation signal completion
686: 	// directly, avoiding runtime polling and propagating failures to dependents.
687: 	var feedWg sync.WaitGroup
688: 	for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
689: 		feedWg.Add(1)
690: 		go func(nodeName string) {
691: 			defer feedWg.Done()
692: 			if err := c.waitForNodeDeployTarget(ctx, nodeName, completed); err != nil {
693: 				finish(nodeName, err)
694: 				return
695: 			}
696: 			select {
697: 			case input <- nodeName:
698: 			case <-ctx.Done():
699: 				finish(nodeName, ctx.Err())
700: 			}
701: 		}(nodeName)
702: 	}
703: 	go func() {
704: 		feedWg.Wait()
705: 		close(input)
706: 	}()
707: 
708: 	var errs []error
709: 	for range nodeNames {
710: 		if err := <-errCh; err != nil {
711: 			errs = append(errs, err)
712: 		}
713: 	}
714: 
715: 	if len(errs) > 0 {
716: 		return errors.Join(errs...)
717: 	}
718: 
719: 	return nil
720: }

728: func (c *CLab) waitForNodeDeployTarget(
729: 	ctx context.Context,
730: 	name string,
731: 	completed map[string]*nodeDeployCompletion,
732: ) error {
733: 	if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
734: 		return err
735: 	}
736: 	target := networkModeContainerTarget(c.Nodes[name].Config().NetworkMode)
737: 	if target == "" {
738: 		target = c.Nodes[name].Config().Labels[clabnodestailscale.ParentLabel]
739: 	}
740: 	if completion, selected := completed[target]; selected {
741: 		select {
742: 		case <-completion.done:
743: 			if completion.err != nil {
744: 				return fmt.Errorf(
745: 					"node %q depends on failed node %q: %w",
746: 					name,
747: 					target,
748: 					completion.err,
749: 				)
750: 			}
751: 			return nil
752: 		case <-ctx.Done():
753: 			return ctx.Err()
754: 		}
755: 	}
756: 	return c.waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget(ctx, name)

759: // waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget waits until a node's network-mode:
760: // container:<target> target is running, so apply's incremental deploy never
761: // races a newly created or recreated target against its dependent. The
762: // target may be a node in this same apply call (added or recreated
763: // alongside the dependent) or, like fresh deploy, an external container not
764: // managed by this topology.
765: func (c *CLab) waitForApplyNetworkModeTarget(ctx context.Context, nodeName string) error {
766: 	node, exists := c.Nodes[nodeName]
767: 	if !exists {
768: 		return nil
769: 	}
770: 
771: 	target := networkModeContainerTarget(node.Config().NetworkMode)
772: 	if target == "" {
773: 		return nil
774: 	}
775: 
776: 	targetNode, internal := c.Nodes[target]
777: 	if !internal {
778: 		return c.waitForExternalNodeDependencies(ctx, nodeName)
779: 	}
780: 
781: 	runtime := c.globalRuntime()
782: 	if runtime == nil {
783: 		return fmt.Errorf("container runtime is not initialized")
784: 	}
785: 
786: 	return clabruntime.WaitForContainerRunning(ctx, runtime, targetNode.Config().LongName, nodeName)
787: }

935: // configureSnapshotRestore configures nodes for snapshot restoration.
936: // It resolves snapshot files for each node and adds the necessary volume mounts
937: // and environment variables to restore from snapshots.
938: func (c *CLab) configureSnapshotRestore(options *DeployOptions) error {
939: 	// Build restore map from per-node specifications
940: 	restoreMap := make(map[string]string)
941: 	for _, mapping := range options.restoreNodeSnapshots {
942: 		parts := strings.SplitN(mapping, "=", 2)
943: 		if len(parts) != 2 {
944: 			return fmt.Errorf("invalid restore format: %s (expected: node=path)", mapping)
945: 		}
946: 		restoreMap[parts[0]] = parts[1]
947: 	}
948: 
949: 	// Track statistics for logging
950: 	var restoredCount, freshCount int
951: 
952: 	// Configure each node
953: 	for _, node := range c.Nodes {
954: 		nodeName := node.Config().ShortName
955: 
956: 		// Resolve snapshot path for this node
957: 		snapshotPath, shouldRestore := resolveNodeSnapshot(nodeName, restoreMap, options.restoreAll)
958: 
959: 		if shouldRestore {
960: 			// Validate snapshot file exists
961: 			if _, err := os.Stat(snapshotPath); os.IsNotExist(err) {
962: 				return fmt.Errorf("snapshot file not found for node %s: %s", nodeName, snapshotPath)
963: 			}
964: 
965: 			// Get absolute path for bind mount
966: 			absPath, err := filepath.Abs(snapshotPath)
967: 			if err != nil {
968: 				return fmt.Errorf("failed to get absolute path for %s: %w", snapshotPath, err)
969: 			}
970: 
971: 			// Add volume mount for snapshot (read-only)
972: 			node.Config().Binds = append(node.Config().Binds,
973: 				fmt.Sprintf("%s:/snapshot.tar:ro", absPath))
974: 
975: 			// Add restore environment variable
976: 			if node.Config().Env == nil {
977: 				node.Config().Env = make(map[string]string)
978: 			}
979: 			node.Config().Env["RESTORE_SNAPSHOT"] = "1"
980: 
981: 			log.Infof("Node %s will restore from: %s", nodeName, snapshotPath)
982: 			restoredCount++
983: 		} else {
984: 			freshCount++
985: 		}
986: 	}
987: 
988: 	// Log deployment mode summary if any restores are configured
989: 	if restoredCount > 0 {
990: 		log.Infof("Deploying %d nodes from snapshots, %d nodes fresh", restoredCount, freshCount)
991: 	}
992: 
993: 	return nil
994: }
995: 
996: // resolveNodeSnapshot determines the snapshot file path for a given node.
997: // Priority: per-node override > restore-all directory > none.
998: func resolveNodeSnapshot(
999: 	nodeName string,
1000: 	restoreMap map[string]string,
1001: 	restoreAll string,
1002: ) (string, bool) {
1003: 	// 1. Check per-node overrides first (highest priority)
1004: 	if snapshotPath, ok := restoreMap[nodeName]; ok {
1005: 		return snapshotPath, true
1006: 	}
1007: 
1008: 	// 2. Check restore-all directory
1009: 	if restoreAll != "" {
1010: 		// Look for {nodename}.tar in directory
1011: 		snapshotPath := filepath.Join(restoreAll, nodeName+".tar")
1012: 		if _, err := os.Stat(snapshotPath); err == nil {
1013: 			return snapshotPath, true
1014: 		}
1015: 
1016: 		// Not found - this is OK, just deploy normally
1017: 		log.Debugf("No snapshot found for node %s in %s, deploying normally", nodeName, restoreAll)
1018: 		return "", false
1019: 	}
1020: 
1021: 	// 3. No restore specified

Now let me look at `createNamespaceSharingDependency` — how does it know the srl node shares a namespace with the holder? It probably checks `NetworkMode` starting with "container:" (from user config). The srl node's own Cfg.NetworkMode is "" (holder pattern), so this dependency is NOT created for the netns holder... but the holder is deployed within the same `node.Deploy` call, so ordering is handled internally. Fine.

But wait — there's a subtlety for `deployNodes` in apply (deployApplyNodes): `waitForNodeDeployTarget` checks `networkModeContainerTarget(c.Nodes[name].Config().NetworkMode)` — for srl with netns, NetworkMode is "" so no wait. Fine, the holder is deployed within srl.Deploy.

Now — a significant question: in apply recreate flow, when a node is recreated, `deployApplyNodes` → `c.deployNode` → PreDeploy → Deploy. srl.Deploy redeploys the holder (new container). OK.

But what about `deleteApplyNodes` — let me check it deletes the node properly (node.Delete). And `parkRecreatedNodes` — parks interfaces using GetNSPath (holder's). OK.

Next: the `distributed` semantics — where is `group.distributed` used in apply? Only in runtimeNodeGroups (to skip duplicates error) and... let me grep for `.distributed` usage. From earlier grep: only tailscale_test and apply_test use it. So `distributed` is basically only used to allow multiple containers in one group. Good — the srl1 group with srl container + holder: srl container has RootNodeName="" → groupName="srl1", distributed=false; holder has RootNodeName="srl1" → distributed=true. Group "srl1" ends with distributed=true, 2 containers. No duplicates error.

BUT — wait, there's an important consideration: in sros, the main container DOES have RootNodeName (sros.go:683 sets it on componentConfig — which is the main srsim component? Let me check). Actually for sros, there might be multiple component containers. Anyway.

Now, what about the case where the srl container exists but holder doesn't (user did `docker rm clab-x-srl1-netns`)? Then srl1 group has 1 container (srl). GetContainerStatus(srl) → Running. apply would plan nothing (no diff) and the lab would run without holder — srl restart policy `unless-stopped` on the srl container would restart it into its own netns... 385: func (c *CLab) destroy(ctx context.Context, maxWorkers uint, keepMgmtNet bool) error {
386: 	var containers []clabruntime.GenericContainer
387: 	var orphanSidecars []clabruntime.GenericContainer
388: 	var err error
389: 
390: 	// If we have nodes defined (from topology file), list containers by node.
391: 	// Otherwise, list containers by lab name label (for destroy-by-name-only case).
392: 	if len(c.Nodes) > 0 {

396: 	}

398: 	if err != nil {

406: 	if len(c.Nodes) > 0 {

408: 		if err != nil {
409: 			return err

412: 			if _, desired := c.Nodes[ctr.Labels[clabconstants.NodeName]]; desired {
413: 				continue
414: 			}
415: 			containers = append(containers, ctr)
416: 			if ctr.Labels[clabconstants.ToolType] == "" {
417: 				orphanSidecars = append(orphanSidecars, ctr)
418: 			}
419: 		}
420: 	}

422: 	if len(containers) == 0 {

424: 	}

426: 	if maxWorkers == 0 {

430: 	log.Info("Destroying lab", "name", c.Config.Name)

432: 	// If we have nodes defined, use the normal node-based deletion.
433: 	// Otherwise, delete containers directly via the runtime (for destroy-by-name-only case).
434: 	if len(c.Nodes) > 0 {

436: 
437: 		err := clablinks.CleanupFilteredLinks(
438: 			ctx,
439: 			c.Config.Topology.Links,

441: 			c.nodeFilter,
442: 		)

557: func (c *CLab) deleteApplyNodes(ctx context.Context, plan *applyPlan) error {
558: 	nodeNames := make([]string, 0, len(plan.deletedNodeSet)+len(plan.recreatedNodeSet))
559: 	for nodeName := range plan.deletedNodeSet {
560: 		nodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)
561: 	}
562: 	for nodeName := range plan.recreatedNodeSet {
563: 		nodeNames = append(nodeNames, nodeName)
564: 	}
565: 	sort.Strings(nodeNames)
566: 
567: 	hookNodes := make([]clabnodes.Node, 0, len(nodeNames))
568: 	var tailscaleContainers []clabruntime.GenericContainer
569: 	for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
570: 		runtimeNode := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]
571: 		if runtimeNode == nil {
572: 			return fmt.Errorf("runtime node %q not found", nodeName)
573: 		}
574: 		if runtimeNode.external || runtimeNode.rootNamespaceBased {
575: 			continue
576: 		}
577: 		if len(runtimeNode.containers) > 0 &&
578: 			runtimeNode.containers[0].Labels[clabconstants.NodeKind] == clabnodestailscale.KindName {
579: 			tailscaleContainers = append(tailscaleContainers, runtimeNode.containers...)
580: 			continue
581: 		}
582: 		if node, ok := c.Nodes[nodeName]; ok {
583: 			hookNodes = append(hookNodes, node)
584: 		}
585: 	}
586: 	var logoutWg sync.WaitGroup
587: 	for _, ctr := range tailscaleContainers {
588: 		logoutWg.Go(func() { c.logoutTailscaleContainer(ctx, ctr) })
589: 	}
590: 	c.preDestroyNodes(ctx, hookNodes, 0)
591: 	logoutWg.Wait()
592: 
593: 	for _, nodeName := range nodeNames {
594: 		runtimeNode := plan.currentNodes[nodeName]
595: 		if runtimeNode.external || runtimeNode.rootNamespaceBased {
596: 			continue
597: 		}
598: 
599: 		for i := len(runtimeNode.containers) - 1; i >= 0; i-- {
600: 			ctr := runtimeNode.containers[i]
601: 			if len(ctr.Names) == 0 {
602: 				return fmt.Errorf("runtime container for node %q has no name", nodeName)
603: 			}
604: 
605: 			runtime := ctr.Runtime
606: 			if runtime == nil {
607: 				runtime = c.globalRuntime()
608: 			}
609: 
610: 			action := "Deleting node"
611: 			if _, recreate := plan.recreatedNodeSet[nodeName]; recreate {
612: 				action = "Deleting node for recreate"
613: 			}
614: 			log.Info(action, "node", nodeName, "container", ctr.Names[0])
615: 			if err := runtime.DeleteContainer(ctx, ctr.Names[0]); err != nil {
616: 				return fmt.Errorf("failed deleting node %q: %w", nodeName, err)
617: 			}
618: 
619: 			_ = clabutils.DeleteNetnsSymlink(ctr.Names[0])
620: 		}
621: 	}
622: 
623: 	return nil
624: }

626: // preDestroyNodes runs the PreDestroy stage of the given nodes concurrently, before any of them
627: // is deleted. Nodes without a container are skipped. A workers value of 0 runs all hooks at once.
628: func (*CLab) preDestroyNodes(ctx context.Context, nodes []clabnodes.Node, workers uint) {
629: 	if workers == 0 || workers > uint(len(nodes)) {
630: 		workers = uint(len(nodes))
631: 	}
632: 
633: 	sem := make(chan struct{}, workers)
634: 	wg := new(sync.WaitGroup)
635: 
636: 	for _, n := range nodes {
637: 		wg.Add(1)
638: 		sem <- struct{}{}
639: 
640: 		go func() {
641: 			defer wg.Done()
642: 			defer func() { <-sem }()
643: 
644: 			if n.GetContainerStatus(ctx) == clabruntime.NotFound {
645: 				return
646: 			}
647: 
648: 			if err := n.PreDestroy(ctx); err != nil {
649: 				log.Warnf("node %q pre-destroy hook failed: %v", n.Config().ShortName, err)
650: 			}
651: 		}()
652: 	}
653: 
654: 	wg.Wait()
655: }

657: func (c *CLab) deleteNodes(ctx context.Context, workers uint) {
658: 	wg := new(sync.WaitGroup)
659: 
660: 	concurrentChan := make(chan clabnodes.Node)
661: 
662: 	workerFunc := func(i uint, input chan clabnodes.Node, wg *sync.WaitGroup) {
663: 		defer wg.Done()
664: 
665: 		for {
666: 			select {
667: 			case n := <-input:
668: 				if n == nil {
669: 					log.Debugf("Worker %d terminating...", i)
670: 					return
671: 				}
672: 
673: 				err := n.Delete(ctx)
674: 				if err != nil {
675: 					log.Errorf("could not remove container %q: %v", n.Config().LongName, err)
676: 				}
677: 			case <-ctx.Done():
678: 				return
679: 			}
680: 		}
681: 	}
682: 
683: 	// start concurrent workers
684: 	wg.Add(int(workers))
685: 
686: 	for i := range workers {
687: 		go workerFunc(i, concurrentChan, wg)
688: 	}
689: 
690: 	// send nodes to workers
691: 	for _, n := range c.Nodes {
692: 		concurrentChan <- n
693: 	}
694: 
695: 	// close channel to terminate the workers
696: 	close(concurrentChan)
697: 
698: 	// also call delete on the special nodes
699: 	specialNodes := append(
700: 		[]clablinks.Node{clablinks.GetHostLinkNode()},
701: 		clablinks.GetMgmtBrLinkNodes()...,
702: 	)
703: 	for _, n := range specialNodes {
704: 		err := n.Delete(ctx)
705: 		if err != nil {
706: 			log.Warn(err)
707: 		}
708: 	}
709: 
710: 	wg.Wait()
711: }

Very important finding candidates in `deleteApplyNodes` (core/destroy.go lines 557-624):

When apply recreates (or deletes) a node, it iterates `runtimeNode.containers` and deletes each container directly via the runtime. For an srl node with the netns holder, the group "srl1" contains BOTH the srl container and the holder. The delete loop deletes both containers: `runtime.DeleteContainer(ctx, ctr.Names[0])`. Good — both get removed.

But wait — it also calls `clabutils.DeleteNetnsSymlink(ctr.Names[0])` for each. For the holder name "clab-x-srl1-netns", DeleteNetnsSymlink removes `/var/run/clab/<name>/pid/netns`? Fine, it doesn't exist. OK.

However: `deleteApplyNodes` does NOT call `node.Delete` — it deletes containers directly. But `preDestroyNodes` runs PreDestroy for hook nodes. Then containers deleted directly. For the srl node that's fine.

Hmm, but there's a subtlety: after deleteApplyNodes deletes both containers, `deployApplyNodes` → `deployNode` → PreDeploy + Deploy. srl.Deploy deploys the holder then the srl container. OK.

Now, what about the ordering of `runtimeNode.containers` in the group: sorted by `runtimeContainerLess` — sort order by runtimeComponentSortOrder(name) which uses last "-" component: "clab-x-srl1" → last component "srl1" → not single alpha → parse digits fails ("srl1" contains letters) → return 0. "clab-x-srl1-netns" → last component "netns" → return 0. Both order 0, then by name. "clab-x-srl1" < "clab-x-srl1-netns" lexicographically. So srl container first, holder second. Delete order: reversed (i from len-1 down): holder deleted first, then srl container. Hmm — deleting the holder first while the srl container still exists with NetworkMode container:holder. Docker allows removing the "source" container? Actually no — Docker refuses to remove a container that others depend on via network mode? Let me think: `docker rm` of a container that other containers reference via `--network container:X` — Docker actually allows removing X? No: "cannot remove container X because other containers are connected to its network" — actually Docker DOES allow removing X; the dependent containers' network mode keeps working? Let me recall: When you remove the container that others share a network namespace with, Docker will error: "cannot remove container X: container Y is using its network namespace"? Hmm. I believe modern Docker allows removing the target and the dependent containers keep running but their network namespace... Actually the netns is kept alive as long as it's referenced. Docker's behavior: `docker rm` on a container that others share netns with fails with "cannot remove container X because other containers are using its network namespace" — hmm, I'm not 100% sure.

Wait — but in the apply recreate flow, `deleteApplyNodes` deletes in reverse sort order: holder first, then srl container. If Docker refuses to delete the holder while the srl container exists (referencing its netns), the recreate would fail with an error.

Actually let me think about what Docker does: the "network mode: container:X" creates a dependency. `docker rm X` when another container Y uses `--network container:X` → Docker returns an error "cannot remove container X because other containers are connected to its network" — hmm, I recall in some Docker versions you CAN remove the shared container and the dependent keeps running with its netns intact (the netns refcount keeps it alive). Actually the classic behavior: docker rm X fails with "conflict: unable to remove container X - container Y is using its network namespace"? Hmm, no wait — I don't think there's a conflict check for network namespaces on rm. There IS for volumes... Let me check the sros implementation: how does sros handle destroy ordering? The sros `Delete` — let me look at nodes/sros/sros.go Delete. If sros deletes the srsim container first and then the holder, that suggests container-first ordering works. In our srl.Delete: `errors.Join(n.DefaultNode.Delete(ctx), n.netnsNode.Delete(ctx))` — DefaultNode.Delete first (srl container), then holder. That ordering is the safe one (remove dependent first).

But `deleteApplyNodes` deletes in reverse of the sorted group order → holder first, then srl. This ordering is the risky one. Let me verify Docker's actual behavior... From Docker docs: "You cannot remove a container that is connected to another running container's network namespace via --network container:". Hmm, actually I believe the check exists: "cannot remove container X: container Y is using the container's network namespace" — no...

Let me search my memory: Docker daemon, when removing a container that is the "network mode" source for another container, returns: `Error response from daemon: cannot remove container "X": container Y is using its network namespace` — Hmm, I genuinely can't be certain. I know Podman returns "container is a dependency of another container (dependency cycle)" or similar. Actually podman: "cannot remove container X: it is a parent of container Y" — podman definitely blocks removing infra containers used by dependent containers (pod infra container). For docker, containers with `--network container:X` have a "link/dependency"... I recall you CAN `docker rm` the netns source and the dependent container continues to run (this is documented: "the network namespace of the container being joined is kept alive as long as a container is using it"? no...).

Actually there's a well-known GitHub issue: docker rm of the container whose netns is shared → error "cannot remove container because other containers are using its network namespace"? Let me not speculate too hard. Instead, let me check how the pre-existing sros netns flow handles apply deletion. 371: 	// with, unless the user pinned the mode explicitly.
372: 	if n.Config().Env["SRL_CHASSIS_MODE"] == "" {
373: 		topology, err := resolveSRLTopology(n.Cfg)
374: 		if err != nil {
375: 			return err
376: 		}
377: 
378: 		if topology.ChassisMode != "" {
379: 			n.Config().Env["SRL_CHASSIS_MODE"] = topology.ChassisMode
380: 		}
381: 	}
382: 
383: 	return n.createSRLFiles()
384: }

386: func (n *srl) PostDeploy(ctx context.Context, params *clabnodes.PostDeployParams) error {
387: 	log.Info("Running postdeploy actions",
388: 		"kind", n.Cfg.Kind,
389: 		"node", n.Cfg.ShortName)
390: 
391: 	// generate the certificate
392: 	certificate, err := n.LoadOrGenerateCertificate(n.cert, n.topologyName)
393: 	if err != nil {
394: 		return err
395: 	}
396: 
397: 	// set the certificate data
398: 	n.Config().TLSCert = string(certificate.Cert)
399: 	n.Config().TLSKey = string(certificate.Key)
400: 
401: 	// Populate /etc/hosts for service discovery on mgmt interface
402: 	if err := n.populateHosts(ctx, params.Nodes); err != nil {
403: 		log.Warnf("Unable to populate hosts for node %q: %v", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
404: 	}
405: 
406: 	// start waiting for initial commit and mgmt server ready
407: 	if err := n.Ready(ctx); err != nil {
408: 		return err
409: 	}
410: 
411: 	n.swVersion, err = n.RunningVersion(ctx)
412: 	if err != nil {
413: 		return err
414: 	}
415: 
416: 	n.supportsOpenconfig, err = n.OpenConfigFeatureEnabled(ctx)
417: 	if err != nil {
418: 		return err
419: 	}
420: 
421: 	// return if config file is found in the lab directory.
422: 	// This can be either if the startup-config has been mounted by that path
423: 	// or the config has been previously generated and saved
424: 	if clabutils.FileExists(filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "config", "config.json")) {
425: 		return nil
426: 	}
427: 
428: 	if err := n.addDefaultConfig(ctx); err != nil {
429: 		return err
430: 	}
431: 
432: 	if err := n.addOverlayCLIConfig(ctx); err != nil {
433: 		return err
434: 	}
435: 
436: 	// once default and overlay config is added, we can commit the config
437: 	if err := n.commitConfig(ctx); err != nil {
438: 		return err
439: 	}
440: 
441: 	return n.generateCheckpoint(ctx)
442: }

469: // Ready returns when the node boot sequence reached the stage when it is ready to accept config
470: // commands
471: // returns an error if not ready by the expiry of the timer readyTimeout.
472: func (n *srl) Ready(ctx context.Context) error {
473: 	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, readyTimeout)
474: 	defer cancel()
475: 
476: 	var err error
477: 
478: 	log.Debugf("Waiting for SR Linux node %q to boot...", n.Cfg.ShortName)
479: 
480: 	for {
481: 		select {
482: 		case <-ctx.Done():
483: 			return fmt.Errorf(
484: 				"timed out waiting for SR Linux node %s to boot: %v",
485: 				n.Cfg.ShortName,
486: 				err,
487: 			)
488: 		default:
489: 			// two commands are checked, first if the mgmt_server is running
490: 			cmd, _ := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(mgmtServerRdyCmd)
491: 
492: 			execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
493: 			if err != nil || (execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0) {
494: 				logMsg := "mgmt_server status check failed"
495: 
496: 				if err != nil {
497: 					logMsg += fmt.Sprintf(" error: %v", err)
498: 				}
499: 
500: 				if execResult != nil && execResult.GetReturnCode() != 0 {
501: 					logMsg += fmt.Sprintf(", output: \n%s", execResult)
502: 				}
503: 
504: 				log.Debug(logMsg)
505: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
506: 
507: 				continue
508: 			}
509: 
510: 			if execResult.GetStdErrString() != "" {
511: 				log.Debugf(
512: 					"error during checking SR Linux boot status: %s",
513: 					execResult.GetStdErrString(),
514: 				)
515: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
516: 
517: 				continue
518: 			}
519: 
520: 			if !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), "running") {
521: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
522: 
523: 				continue
524: 			}
525: 
526: 			// once mgmt server is running, we need to check if it is ready to accept configuration
527: 			// commands
528: 			// this is done with checking readyForConfigCmd
529: 			cmd, _ = clabexec.NewExecCmdFromString(readyForConfigCmd)
530: 
531: 			execResult, err = n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
532: 			if err != nil {
533: 				log.Debugf("error during readyForConfigCmd execution: %s", err)
534: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
535: 
536: 				continue
537: 			}
538: 
539: 			if execResult.GetStdErrString() != "" {
540: 				log.Debugf("readyForConfigCmd stderr: %s", execResult.GetStdErrString())
541: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
542: 
543: 				continue
544: 			}
545: 
546: 			if !strings.Contains(execResult.GetStdOutString(), "loaded initial configuration") {
547: 				log.Debugf(
548: 					"Management server readiness files doesn't contain the marker string %s",
549: 					execResult.GetStdOutString(),
550: 				)
551: 				time.Sleep(retryTimer)
552: 
553: 				continue
554: 			}
555: 
556: 			log.Debugf("Node %s is ready to accept configs", n.Cfg.ShortName)
557: 
558: 			return nil
559: 		}
560: 	}
561: }

593: func (n *srl) createSRLFiles() error {
594: 	log.Debugf("Creating directory structure for SRL container: %s", n.Cfg.ShortName)
595: 
596: 	var src string
597: 
598: 	if n.Cfg.License != "" {
599: 		// copy license file to node specific directory in lab
600: 		src = n.Cfg.License
601: 
602: 		licPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "license.key")
603: 		if err := clabutils.CopyFile(context.Background(), src, licPath,
604: 			clabconstants.PermissionsFileDefault); err != nil {
605: 			return fmt.Errorf("CopyFile src %s -> dst %s failed %v", src, licPath, err)
606: 		}
607: 
608: 		log.Debugf("CopyFile src %s -> dst %s succeeded", src, licPath)
609: 	}
610: 
611: 	// generate SRL topology file, including base MAC
612: 	err := generateSRLTopologyFile(n.Cfg)
613: 	if err != nil {
614: 		return err
615: 	}
616: 
617: 	clabutils.CreateDirectory(path.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "config"),
618: 		clabconstants.PermissionsOpen)
619: 
620: 	// create repository files (for yum/apt) that
621: 	// are mounted to srl container during the init phase
622: 	err = n.createRepoFiles()
623: 	if err != nil {
624: 		return err
625: 	}
626: 
627: 	// generate a startup config file
628: 	// if the node has a `startup-config:` statement, the file specified in that section
629: 	// will be used as a template in GenerateConfig()
630: 	var cfgTemplate string
631: 
632: 	cfgPath := filepath.Join(n.Cfg.LabDir, "config", "config.json")
633: 	if n.Cfg.StartupConfig != "" {
634: 		log.Debug("Reading startup-config", "file", n.Cfg.StartupConfig)
635: 
636: 		c, err := os.ReadFile(n.Cfg.StartupConfig)
637: 		if err != nil {
638: 			return err
639: 		}
640: 
641: 		cBuf, err := clabutils.SubstituteEnvsAndTemplate(bytes.NewReader(c), n.Cfg)
642: 		if err != nil {
643: 			return err
644: 		}
645: 
646: 		// Determine if startup-config is a JSON file
647: 		// Get slice of data with optional leading whitespace removed.
648: 		// See RFC 7159, Section 2 for the definition of JSON whitespace.
649: 		x := bytes.TrimLeft(cBuf.Bytes(), " \t\r\n")
650: 
651: 		isJSON := len(x) > 0 && x[0] == '{'
652: 		if !isJSON {
653: 			log.Debugf(
654: 				"startup-config passed to %s is in the CLI format. Will apply it in post-deploy stage",
655: 				n.Cfg.ShortName,
656: 			)
657: 
658: 			n.startupCliCfg = cBuf.Bytes()
659: 
660: 			// no need to generate and mount startup-config passed in a CLI format
661: 			// as we will apply it over the top of a default config in the post deploy stage
662: 			return nil
663: 		}
664: 
665: 		cfgTemplate = cBuf.String()
666: 	}
667: 
668: 	if cfgTemplate == "" {
669: 		log.Debugf(
670: 			"configuration template for node %s is empty, skipping startup config file generation",
671: 			n.Cfg.ShortName,
672: 		)
673: 
674: 		return nil
675: 	}
676: 
677: 	err = n.GenerateConfig(cfgPath, cfgTemplate)
678: 	if err != nil {
679: 		log.Errorf("node=%s, failed to generate config: %v", n.Cfg.ShortName, err)
680: 	}
681: 
682: 	return err
683: }

732: // addDefaultConfig adds srl default configuration such as tls certs, gnmi/json-rpc, login-banner.
733: func (n *srl) addDefaultConfig(ctx context.Context) error {
734: 	b, err := n.banner()
735: 	if err != nil {
736: 		return err
737: 	}
738: 
739: 	var dnsServers []string
740: 	if n.Config().DNS != nil {
741: 		dnsServers = n.Config().DNS.Servers
742: 	}
743: 
744: 	// tplData holds data used in templating of the default config snippet
745: 	tplData := srlTemplateData{
746: 		TLSKey:           n.Cfg.TLSKey,
747: 		TLSCert:          n.Cfg.TLSCert,
748: 		TLSAnchor:        n.Cfg.TLSAnchor,
749: 		Banner:           b,
750: 		IFaces:           map[string]tplIFace{},
751: 		MgmtMTU:          0,
752: 		MgmtIPMTU:        0,
753: 		DNSServers:       dnsServers,
754: 		SNMPConfig:       snmpv2Config,
755: 		GRPCConfig:       grpcConfig,
756: 		OCServerConfig:   "",
757: 		NDKServerConfig:  "",
758: 		DNSServersConfig: "",
759: 	}
760: 
761: 	if err := n.setVersionSpecificParams(&tplData); err != nil {
762: 		return err
763: 	}
764: 
765: 	n.setCustomPrompt(&tplData)
766: 
767: 	// set MgmtMTU to the MTU value of the runtime management network
768: 	// so that the two MTUs match.
769: 	tplData.MgmtIPMTU = n.Runtime.Mgmt().MTU
770: 
771: 	if err := n.populateInterfaceConfig(&tplData); err != nil {
772: 		return err
773: 	}
774: 
775: 	buf := new(bytes.Buffer)
776: 
777: 	err = srlCfgTpl.Execute(buf, tplData)
778: 	if err != nil {
779: 		return err
780: 	}
781: 
782: 	log.Debugf("Node %q additional config:\n%s", n.Cfg.ShortName, buf.String())
783: 
784: 	// Copy overlay config to container
785: 	tmpFilePath, err := clabutils.WriteToTempFile(buf.String())
786: 	if err != nil {
787: 		return err
788: 	}
789: 	defer os.Remove(tmpFilePath)
790: 
791: 	err = n.Runtime.CopyToContainer(ctx, n.Cfg.LongName, defaultCfgPath, tmpFilePath)
792: 	if err != nil {
793: 		return fmt.Errorf("error copying configuration to container: %w", err)
794: 	}
795: 
796: 	// su to admin user to apply the default config
797: 	// to make sure that the 'environment save' command will create
798: 	// files with correct permissions
799: 	cmd := clabexec.NewExecCmdFromSlice([]string{
800: 		"bash", "-c",
801: 		fmt.Sprintf("su -s /bin/bash admin -c '/opt/srlinux/bin/sr_cli -ed < %s'", defaultCfgPath),
802: 	})
803: 
804: 	execResult, err := n.RunExec(ctx, cmd)
805: 	if err != nil {
806: 		return err
807: 	}
808: 
809: 	log.Debugf(
810: 		"node %s. stdout: %s, stderr: %s",
811: 		n.Cfg.ShortName,
812: 		execResult.GetStdOutString(),
813: 		execResult.GetStdErrString(),
814: 	)
815: 
816: 	return nil
817: }

819: // populateInterfaceConfig adds endpoint settings to the default configuration,
820: // returning an error for interface names that cannot be mapped to SR Linux interfaces.
821: func (n *srl) populateInterfaceConfig(tplData *srlTemplateData) error {
822: 	const ethernetSplitParts = 3
823: 
824: 	const ethernetMTUOverhead = 14
825: 
826: 	for _, e := range n.Endpoints {
827: 		ifName := e.GetIfaceName()
828: 
829: 		// Runtime-discovered endpoints bypass topology interface-name validation.
830: 		if !normalizedInterfaceRegexp.MatchString(ifName) {
831: 			return fmt.Errorf(
832: 				"invalid SR Linux interface %q: expected %s or %s",
833: 				ifName, mgmt0InterfaceName, InterfaceHelp,
834: 			)
835: 		}
836: 
837: 		// Restored runtime endpoints may have no topology link or configured MTU.
838: 		mtu := clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU
839: 		if link := e.GetLink(); link != nil {
840: 			mtu = link.GetMTU()
841: 		}
842: 
843: 		if ifName == mgmt0InterfaceName {
844: 			if mtu != clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU {
845: 				tplData.MgmtMTU = mtu
846: 				tplData.MgmtIPMTU = mtu - ethernetMTUOverhead
847: 			}
848: 
849: 			continue
850: 		}
851: 
852: 		ifNameParts := strings.SplitN(strings.TrimPrefix(ifName, "e"), "-", ethernetSplitParts)
853: 
854: 		iface := tplIFace{}
855: 
856: 		iface.BaseName = fmt.Sprintf("ethernet-%s/%s", ifNameParts[0], ifNameParts[1])
857: 		if len(ifNameParts) == ethernetSplitParts {
858: 			iface.FullName = fmt.Sprintf("%s/%s", iface.BaseName, ifNameParts[2])
859: 			iface.HasBreakout = true
860: 		} else {
861: 			iface.FullName = iface.BaseName
862: 		}
863: 
864: 		if mtu != clabconstants.DefaultLinkMTU {
865: 			iface.Mtu = mtu
866: 		}
867: 
868: 		if a := e.GetIPv4Addr(); a.IsValid() {
869: 			iface.IPv4 = a.String()
870: 		}
871: 
872: 		if a := e.GetIPv6Addr(); a.IsValid() {
873: 			iface.IPv6 = a.String()
874: 		}
875: 
876: 		tplData.IFaces[ifName] = iface
877: 	}
878: 
879: 	return nil
880: }
